text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows hypoxemia (low oxygen saturation), mild anemia, leukopenia, lymphopenia, thrombocytopenia, and elevated monocytes and basophils, suggesting possible bone marrow suppression or systemic inflammation/infection. Elevated creatinine indicates impaired renal function. Low total protein may reflect poor nutritional status or protein loss. Further clinical correlation and investigation are recommended.
